module: Node "On Menu" (repeat_instant). Detects the opening of an interface menu (Escape menu), based on core_input_bindings.getMenuActionMapEnabled() and the absence of loading. Input: reset (pulse). Outputs: open, close (flow), onOpened and onClosed (pulses, hidden), openOrClosed (bool, hidden).
notes: Leaves debug prints ("OnMenu Debug") on every state change.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

reset.desc: Resets the previous state to "none": the next frame will emit a pulse.

work.desc: Computes the open/closed state and writes open, close, openOrClosed; emits the onOpened or onClosed pulse on state change, then resets them to false on the next frame.
